howto: Choose which sums to practise (+, -, × and ÷) and a level, then press Start.
Work out the sum at the top and steer the snake onto the number with the answer.
A wrong number or a wall costs a heart. You have three.
tips: Pick the wrong number twice and the right one starts to glow.
Four right answers in a row start a Frenzy: extra points for 10 seconds.
Every 5 in a row wins back a heart.
Gold stars are worth 25 bonus points, and the treasure chest holds a surprise.
Wrong numbers hop to a new spot now and then, so plan a clear path.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD steer. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe on the board or use the on-screen arrow buttons

difficulty: Five level bands with an age guide: Easy (ages 5-6), Medium (7-8), Hard (9-10, times tables to 12), Insane (11-12) and Max (13+). Harder bands unlock with XP, and the snake speeds up as the score grows.

features.age-or-level-bands: Level buttons on the title, each with an age guide, plus a choice of +, -, × and ÷
features.hints: After two wrong picks the right number glows; the arcade Hint gives a strategy for the current sum
features.grown-up-progress-report: Grown-ups button on the title: answers and accuracy per level, practice days, the sums missed most and a suggested next level
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first game (the snake waits); replay with Learn to play
features.results: Game Over card with score, best, bonus stars, trophy and lifetime numbers eaten
